title_en: Arrangement of the Supreme People's Court on Mutual Enforcement of Arbitral Awards Between the Mainland and the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

articles.content_en: Article 1 Where a party fails to perform an arbitral award made in the Mainland or the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, the other party may apply to the relevant court at the domicile of the respondent or the location of the property for enforcement of the award.

Article 2 The "relevant court" referred to in the preceding Article means, in the Mainland, the Intermediate People's Court at the domicile of the respondent or the location of the property, and in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, the High Court of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.
Where the domicile of the respondent or the location of the property falls within the jurisdiction of different Intermediate People's Courts in the Mainland, the applicant may choose one of such People's Courts to apply for enforcement of the award and shall not apply to two or more People's Courts separately.
Where the domicile of the respondent or the location of the property is located both in the Mainland and the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, the applicant shall not simultaneously apply to the relevant courts in both places separately. Only if enforcement by the court in one place is insufficient to satisfy the debt may the applicant apply to the court in the other place for enforcement of the shortfall. The total amount enforced by the courts in the two places successively shall not exceed the amount of the award.

Article 5 The time limit for an applicant to apply to the relevant court for enforcement of an arbitral award made in the Mainland or the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall be governed by the provisions on time limits of the law of the place where the enforcement is sought.
Article 6 Upon receipt of an application, the relevant court shall handle and enforce it in accordance with the legal procedures of the place where the enforcement is sought.

Article 8 An applicant who applies to the relevant court for enforcement of an arbitral award made in the Mainland or the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall pay the enforcement fees in accordance with the measures on litigation fees of the court where enforcement is sought.
Article 9 Applications for enforcement of arbitral awards made in the Mainland or the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region after July 1, 1997 shall be governed by this Arrangement.

Article 10 With respect to applications for enforcement of awards made between July 1, 1997 and the date on which this Arrangement takes effect, the Parties agree as follows:
If, for any reason, an application for enforcement could not be made to a Mainland court or a court of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region during the period from July 1, 1997 to the date on which this Arrangement takes effect, and the applicant is a legal person or other organization, the application may be made within six months after the date on which this Arrangement takes effect; if the applicant is a natural person, the application may be made within one year after the date on which this Arrangement takes effect.
With respect to cases in which a Mainland court or a court of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region refused to accept or refused to enforce an arbitral award during the period from July 1, 1997 to the date on which this Arrangement takes effect, the parties shall be allowed to re-apply.

Article 11 Any questions arising in the course of implementation of this Arrangement and any amendments thereto shall be resolved through consultation between the Supreme People's Court and the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.
(List of Mainland Arbitration Commissions (omitted))
